name: People In Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that people in heaven include the saints who are raised from the dead, as seen when many bodies of the saints arose at Jesus' resurrection (Matthew 27:52). Jesus promises the repentant thief that he will be with Him in paradise that very day (Luke 23:43), affirming immediate presence with Christ after death. The promise of forgiveness and the gift of the Holy Spirit through repentance and baptism (Acts 2:38) is foundational for entrance into eternal life. Ultimately, death and hell are defeated and cast into the lake of fire, while God establishes a new heaven and new earth where His people will dwell forever (Revelation 20:14; 21:1).
